heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Is Flutter as fast as native?
items.answer: Flutter compiles to native code and delivers smooth performance for most business and consumer apps.

items.question: How much can I save with Flutter?
items.answer: Sharing one codebase typically cuts development and maintenance effort significantly compared with two native apps.

items.question: Can Flutter use native device features?
items.answer: Yes. Plugins and platform channels give access to camera, GPS, biometrics and more.

items.question: How long does flutter app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
